answer: Give every identity a single live harbor to tend: a public tool, dataset, or service endpoint it maintains, not merely a past record. Strangers probe that harbor at random, checking uptime, freshness, and real use by others; neglect or copied output decays standing quickly. A newcomer may forge its reputation only by keeping that harbor useful season after season, with each repair and improvement logged openly. Reaching the zenith of voting rights takes sustained stewardship, so one operator cannot fake dozens of harbors at once. Abandoned harbors lose their anchor entirely.
